title: AnnotationSet
description: The wire form of one annotation_sets row with its annotation_readers rows (0006_evidence.up.sql sections 7 and 8): chapter 7 section 7.5's frozen reference standard. Response body of table 10.2-B rows R29 and R31, item type of row R30. It is the third of the three ids POST /api/v1/training-runs binds (MOS-TRAIN-124, MOS-EVID-040), and the readers are projected rather than reduced to a count because MOS-EVID-043 requires inter-reader agreement in every report citing a multi-reader set and MOS-UI-125 requires the console to have said so before the campaign started. There is no PATCH and no DELETE on this resource: MOS-TRAIN-110 makes adding a reader or a case a NEW set bound to the same DatasetVersion, and annotation_sets_frozen refuses the other reading.

consensus_params.description: Projected in full, including staple's rng_seed: MOS-TRAIN-105 requires the reduction to be reproducible from the persisted per-reader masks alone, and a parameter recorded in a column nobody serves is a parameter nobody can reproduce from.

reader_count.description: MOS-EVID-038: at least one. annotation_sets_single_reader and annotation_sets_majority tie it to the consensus rule in the database as well as in medos/medos/evidence/repo.py.

reader_id.description: The MedicalOS User principal. A principal id and not a name: MOS-API-006 forbids a direct identifier in a response body, and a reader's name is one.

tool.description: Filled by the platform from the deployed annotation stack, never typed by the operator (MOS-UI-124).

reference_of_record.description: MOS-EVID-042. False on a set any of whose readers has role `algorithm`: an algorithmic reference standard is never the reference of record, and medos/medos/evidence/repo.py refuses the combination at freeze rather than letting an AcceptanceCriteria gate discover it later.

annotation_digest.description: Chapter 7's annotation_digest; section 12.12 spells the column manifest_digest. MOS-TRAIN-124 binds it onto the TrainingRun and MOS-TRAIN-140 requires the candidate EvaluationRun to carry the same one, which is what makes 'fitted and evaluated against the same reference standard' checkable rather than asserted.
